from slugify import slugify

def test_replacements_iter_one_shot():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([('-', '+')])) == 'a+b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([('-', '+')])) == slugify('a b', replacements=[('-', '+')])

def test_replacements_pairs_one_shot():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([iter(['-', '+'])])) == 'a+b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([iter(['-', '+'])])) == slugify('a b', replacements=[('-', '+')])

def test_replacements_order_preserved():
    assert slugify('x y z', replacements=iter([('x', '1'), ('y', '2'), ('z', '3')])) == '1-2-3'
    assert slugify('x y z', replacements=iter([('x', '1'), ('y', '2'), ('z', '3')])) == slugify('x y z', replacements=[('x', '1'), ('y', '2'), ('z', '3')])

def test_stopwords_iter_lowercase():
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop'])) == 'keep-tail'
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop'])) == slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=['Drop'])

def test_stopwords_iter_case_sensitive():
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop']), lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop']), lowercase=False) == slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=['Drop'], lowercase=False)

def test_stopwords_first_word_not_stopword():
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop']), lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Drop Keep Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop']), lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'

def test_no_mutation():
    repl = [('-', '+')]
    repl_copy = list(repl)
    slugify('a b', replacements=repl)
    assert repl == repl_copy
    sw = ['Drop']
    sw_copy = list(sw)
    slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=sw)
    assert sw == sw_copy

def test_none_and_empty():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=None) == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=()) == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=None) == 'keep-drop-tail'
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=()) == 'keep-drop-tail'

def test_existing_behavior():
    assert slugify('10 | 20 %', replacements=[['|', 'or'], ['%', 'percent']]) == '10-or-20-percent'
    assert slugify('this has a stopword', stopwords=['stopword']) == 'this-has-a'
    assert slugify('thIs Has a stopword Stopword', stopwords=['Stopword'], lowercase=False) == 'thIs-Has-a-stopword'
    assert slugify('jaja---lol-méméméoo--a', max_length=9) == 'jaja-lol'
    assert slugify('jaja---lol-méméméoo--a', max_length=20, word_boundary=True, separator='.') == 'jaja.lol.mememeoo.a'
